patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Enter the "DLC" folder inside the game install folder Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the contents of the downloaded patch archive into "DLC" folder mentioned above It's working if: In the gallery there is a "movies" section for each of the girls, as well as the photo gallery.
